project.title: Qualitative Study Needing No Code or Equations

research.concept: How first-generation university students describe belonging during their first semester.
research.problemStatement: Belonging shapes retention, but first-generation students' own accounts of belonging in the first semester are under-studied in this regional context.

researchQuestions.text: How do first-generation students describe moments of belonging and exclusion in their first semester?

objectives: Collect first-person accounts via semi-structured interviews.
Develop themes through reflexive thematic analysis.

contributions.text: A thematic framework describing first-semester belonging for first-generation students in this context.

researchGap.statement: Prior work measures retention quantitatively but rarely captures students' own accounts of belonging in this region.

limitations: Single institution; findings are transferable, not generalizable.
